messages:
Ravi (eng-arch): Quick sync: we need an ownership and cutover plan for fastpath vs tiling. Main asks: who owns route-policy decisions, what metrics gate cutover, and a minimal rollback playbook.
Nina (eng-platform): Owning policy config should live in platform-config (single source). Platform implements route-level flags, runtime just reads. That avoids duplicating logic.
Lina (eng-auth): Agreed on central config, but auth decisions must remain canonical in auth service. Fastpath can consult a signed permit blob to avoid rps to auth on every request.
Sam (eng-sre): SLO constraints: we can't accept tiling p99 > 4x current baseline on rollouts. We need tenant-level circuit breakers and visible per-tenant backpressure metrics.
Ravi (eng-arch): Proposed split of responsibilities: platform-config (Nina) owns policy surface; runtime (Nina+Sam) owns enforcement; auth (Lina) provides signed allow-lists / delta tokens; arch (Ravi) coordinates rollout playbook and proofs.
Nina (eng-platform): Implementation sketch: route metadata includes: lane_hint (fastpath|tiling|auto), resource_cost_score (int), auth_scope_hash. Runtime uses lane_hint or computes lane via cost thresholds.
Lina (eng-auth): Signed blobs: ephemeral JWT-style allow-list with exp and version. Runtime verifies signature and timestamp, then validates requested scopes locally. On miss, runtime does a synchronous call to auth service.
Sam (eng-sre): We must define observables. Minimum: per-route p50/p95/p99, auth-blob hit-rate, auth-sync rate, lane-switch rate, per-tenant queue-depth, aborted-by-circuit counts. Alerts: auth-sync rate spike, lane-switch > 3% per 5m, tenant queue-depth > 200.
Ravi (eng-arch): Rollout gates: start 0.5% traffic, 30m hold. Gate checks: error-rate delta < 0.2%, p95 < 2x baseline, p99 < 3x baseline, auth-sync rate delta < 10rps. Auto-roll back if any gate fails.
Nina (eng-platform): Migration checklist: one-off job to precompute allow-lists for hot tenants, feature-flag for route metadata, AB test harness, canary runner in us-east only first.
Lina (eng-auth): Backfill plan: run allow-list generator from last 7 days of traffic, materialize per-tenant blobs in auth-store, version them so runtime can pick v1->v2 during cutover.
Sam (eng-sre): Circuit: per-tenant token-bucket, when exceeded mark tenant noisy and route to a throttled pool. Add tenant-noise dashboard and ticketing automation to notify CSE.
Ravi (eng-arch): Testing: unit tests for signature verification, integration test with signed-blob miss->sync path, chaos test simulating auth-store latency, soak test for 24h at 10% traffic.
Nina (eng-platform): Config schema snippet (will add to repo):
```
route_policy:
  lane_hint: auto
  cost_score: 12
  auth_scope_hash: "sha256:.."
```
Sam (eng-sre): Also add a "force_lane" override that only devs can use for repro. Important for debugging.
Lina (eng-auth): Observability: auth logs must include: request_id, tenant_id, blob_version, resolved_scopes, decision_source (blob|sync). We need these for audits.
ci-bot: ci-bot: New PR created: platform/route-policy-schema #482 (tests: 12 passed, 1 flaky).
Ravi (eng-arch): Rollback playbook (short): 1) Flip feature-flag to route_policy=legacy; 2) Drain tiling workers; 3) Re-issue global signed-blobs TTL to 0 to force sync paths to auth; 4) Notify SRE + Product. Document in runbook.
Nina (eng-platform): Who signs off on final thresholds? Suggest small committee: Ravi, Sam, Lina, and one PM. We can iterate after first canary.
Sam (eng-sre): I want an emergency abort condition: if p99 for any top-10 tenant crosses 5x baseline, abort immediately.
Lina (eng-auth): We'll add a header that encodes blob_source and signature-id for quick triage.
Ravi (eng-arch): OK owners confirmed: Nina (platform impl), Lina (auth blobs), Sam (SRE gates + circuit), Ravi (coord + docs). I'll draft follow-up RFC updates and post in docs repo. Follow-up sync tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Nina (eng-platform): I'll create the feature flags and config PRs today, link them in the RFC.
Sam (eng-sre): I'll spin up a tenant-noise sim to validate circuit behavior.
Lina (eng-auth): I'll start allow-list backfill and a small end-to-end test harness.
Ravi (eng-arch): Great. Final ask: include sample queries that should always be fastpath (dashboard tiles with single-row aggregates) vs ones that must go to tiling (cross-tenant joins). Put examples in RFC. Closing thread unless blockers.
